purpose: Independently test the legacy-over-phase2 capture-branch-expansion manifestation reversal observed in E-019 D3, using a new seed block and the same paired game-level endpoint without changing any prior experiment decision.
hypothesis: Under fixed hard / bao / depth 3 conditions, eligible category-A capture-branch-expansion manifestation is more frequent under legacy search than under phase2 search.
interpretationBoundary: E-020 tests only hard / bao / depth 3. It does not retroactively confirm the E-019 D3 observation, does not alter E-019/H17, does not establish monotonic depth dependence or a general search-profile-by-depth interaction, and does not generalize to other evaluators or future search implementations.

designSources: E-019 formal D3 observation and completion checkpoint
independence.designUseOnly: Prior results are used only to motivate the prospective reversed-direction hypothesis, preserve the paired endpoint, and select a conservative sample size before E-020 data generation. E-019 is not reused as confirmatory evidence for H18.

primaryUnit.name: paired shared-seed game
primaryUnit.pairingRequirement: P2 and LG must use the same seed and identical random-opening boundary state for each paired game.
primaryUnit.binaryEndpointPerCondition: 1 if the game contains at least one category-A candidate in the primary population classified as capture-branch-expansion; otherwise 0.

primaryEndpoint.name: paired D3 search-profile difference in capture-branch-expansion manifestation
primaryEndpoint.comparison: legacy versus phase2 on the paired game-level binary endpoint
primaryEndpoint.test: two-sided exact McNemar test on discordant pairs
primaryEndpoint.directionRequirement: legacy-only discordant pairs must exceed phase2-only discordant pairs
reportedEffectMeasures: discordant-pair odds ratio legacy-only/phase2-only with infinity reported when phase2-only=0

sampleSizeDesign.rationale: Use the same paired N as E-019 D3 for direct replication comparability while checking power under assumptions materially weaker than the E-019 D3 observation.
sampleSizeDesign.caveat: The E-019 D3 observation is context, not confirmation for H18. No E-020 observed data may be used to revise N, seed range, endpoint, direction, minimum discordants, alpha, or the decision contract after formal generation begins.

decisionRule.confirmed: Formal corpus integrity and exact pairing pass, exactly 4500 pairs are evaluated, at least 20 discordant paired games are available, the two-sided exact McNemar p-value is <=0.05, and legacy-only discordant pairs exceed phase2-only discordant pairs.
decisionRule.notConfirmed: Formal corpus integrity and exact pairing pass and at least 20 discordant paired games are available, but the preregistered significance or prospective legacy-over-phase2 direction criterion fails.
decisionRule.inconclusive: Corpus generation, schema/hash/source validation, paired-opening validation, seed pairing, candidate-event construction, required output construction, exact pair-count verification, or minimum 20 discordant-pair availability fails.

perCondition: trajectory-ply-deduplicated candidate versus control expansion rates and risk ratio
structuralSecondaryEndpoint.directComparison: Compare capture-branch-expansion rates among unique candidate trajectory-ply units between legacy and phase2; report Fisher exact two-sided p-value, risk ratio, and risk difference.
structuralSecondaryEndpoint.decisionBoundary: Structural secondary results never replace, override, rescue, or reverse the paired game-level McNemar primary decision.

mechanismBridgeSecondary.purpose: Preserve quantities needed to hand off to Study 1 Stage B without turning mechanism exploration into a second confirmatory claim.
outputs: raw candidate occurrence count by condition
raw expansion manifestation count by condition
forced-capture regime length and candidate position summaries
mechanismBridgeSecondary.decisionBoundary: No mechanism-bridge output changes the E-020 primary decision. Detailed trajectory divergence and depth-boundary mechanism analysis remains Stage B.

executionPolicy.approvalRequirement: A separate explicit user instruction specific to E-020 is required after preregistration and infrastructure validation and before any E-020 formal seed is generated.

changePolicy: Any post-preregistration change to sample size, seed range, conditions, candidate/regime thresholds, primary population, primary unit, exact McNemar test, alpha, prospective direction, minimum discordant pairs, decision contract, or primary/secondary boundary requires a new preregistration version. E-020 results may not be used to relax this file after formal data generation starts.
